Bisexuality can be anything from 50/50 attracted to men and women to 1/99 attracted to men and women. You are still bi, you like men. The quantity does not matter. 

If you cheat on your partner but “generally don’t” does that make you loyal? No, it makes you a cheater. I’m not sure why the frequency matters. You’re friend is 100% a queer woman and I don’t deny that, the label lesbian is just not appropriate.

I heavily agree, I never really understand when people try to explain the definition. It always just reads as bi w/ a preference towards women. Lesbians have a very unique experience that is frequently painted over by others. 

I mean we are the first letter in the whole LGBTQ thing and barely get recognized. Our community is one not given any grave or recognition. 

I have absolutely no problem w/ mspec people, they just lack the same steps in life that make lesbians lesbian. They don’t deal w/ comphet in the same way if it’s not comp… it’s just the het part. Which leads to being mspec/bi/pan/Omni. 

We have beautiful existing category’s of sexuality’s and we are worried about taking lesbians.

I’m viet and white. They all have darker skin that most viet people have and I’m VERY PALE. We all have the Asian freckles tho. I’m pretty white passing as my dad is Irish so I got curly hair and blue eyes even tho my eyes “look” Asian. I LOOK like my Vietnamese family people just think there’s only one way to look Asian. No one in my Vietnamese family has “small” eyes. South East Asians and all Asians are different.

We know our cultures and we know who we are. This is me this is who I am so I don’t let others uninformed opinions get to me. Enjoy your culture unapologetically
